subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps and evaluation kickoff

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. High-level recap: Acme is looking to run a 2–4 week evaluation focused on extracting structured insights from customer support transcripts, with an emphasis on latency and cost per-1M tokens. You mentioned success criteria around 1) model parity on classification accuracy vs your current baseline, 2) end-to-end latency under 300ms for streaming inference on 4k tokens, and 3) predictable unit cost under your target threshold.

Next step: schedule an evaluation kickoff (technical deep dive + trial plan). Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed, Jun 24 — 08:00–09:00 or 11:00–12:00
- Fri, Jun 26 — 09:00–10:00

Please let me know which works (or share other availability) and who else should join from your side. We typically run the kickoff with: AE (me), Solutions Engineer (Connor), and your ML/infra owner + a PM.

Attached: Redwood-Trial-Plan-v1.pdf (high-level goals, evaluation checklist, example prompt set). I can update this after we confirm attendees.

Quick ask: can you share one or two representative transcript examples (redacted) prior to the call so Connor can validate tokenization and performance expectations?

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182
[Attachment: Redwood-Trial-Plan-v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks Marissa — really helpful recap.

We’re excited to move forward. Wednesday (Jun 24) could work for us — available windows (EST): 11:00–12:00 or 14:00–15:00. Friday morning is also an option but would prefer Wed if possible.

Please include our ML engineer Raj Patel (raj.patel@acme.com) and our head of support Priya Shah on the invite. For the transcript examples, I’ll pull two redacted files and share by end of day tomorrow.

Agenda request: can you share a 30–45 minute agenda focused on the trial plan + quick environment/ingestion checklist? We have a short procurement checklist to kick off internal approvals, so the more structured the kickoff the better.

—Alex

Product Lead, AI Platforms | Acme Corp
